dialogues.text_en: Have you had enough rest, Forename? Good. Everyone appears to have settled in, so I think we're ready to resume our discussion...
Before that, though, I have a favor to ask of you. It's about Estinien.
According to a certain lord commander, our missing friend was but recently sighted in Ishgard.
This may be the best chance we have to catch him! Please, Forename─won't you head to the Holy See and track him down?
Thank you! If you lie in wait at the aetheryte plaza, I'm hopeful you'll spot him before long.
Forename... If I didn't know better, I would think this a coincidence.
What brings you back to Eorzea? Is all well in Tural?
So the real Sphene awakened, after which this Calyx reared his head... You've been busy.
As have the new Dawnservants. They continue to do their old man proud, it seems.
Given all that had come to pass, it would only be natural for Tuliyollal and Alexandria to remain at odds.
But instead they have embraced each other. And it is thanks to those who desired and labored for a brighter future.
An eye for an eye. A life for a life. Such is the cycle of vengeance.
It took Ishgard a thousand years to break free from it.
Had the rift between man and wyrm been mended sooner, how different life might have been.
For me and my family. For Aymeric and the archbishop. And for Ysayle too...
Pay me no heed. 'Twas idle musing, nothing more.
I've just been to visit Hraesvelgr, to share news of Azdaja. Mayhap a bout of nostalgia came over me.
Missing? Let's not be melodramatic. I was “difficult to reach” at worst.
My linkpearl? Somewhere in my pack, I expect. I haven't handled it since I put it away.
At any rate, I'll make for the Rising Stones. You can tell me all about our new dilemma there.
Tataru is being rather prickly. What could she be upset about?
There you are! Thank you so much for finding Estinien!
Hmph, you needn't fuss over me as if I were a lost child.
While we had faith that you were safe and well, without *any* response, we couldn't help but worry. In future, please make an effort to stay in contact!
Now then, I shall take a moment to catch Estinien up on events, after which we will reconvene to discuss the Solstice.
Please wait in Dawn's Respite until then!
Lest you worry, it suits me just fine to be here. Far better than being left behind in some long-winded meeting.
Hmm... I see no signs of Calyx or Halmarut.
Mayhap they are hiding, or simply not nearby. But without their insights, we shall have to get our bearings for ourselves.
Take heart, my friend. As before, we will find our way through this. One step at a time, through ice and snow.
